# Proposed customer-facing text — owner review before production

Date:7November2026. Review branch only. This document expands the actual build data; placeholders are not shown to customers. Original company handbooks unavailable; latest explicit owner decisions support the confirmed numerical rules. Production has NOT been updated by this task.

## Terms & Conditions

Route: /terms-and-conditions/

Read these general customer conditions together with your quotation and official confirmation. Contact us to clarify the arrangements applicable to your request before accepting.

### Identity and scope

Mr Sewing Fashion operates under NINKONIYUMUTWARE NEXUS LTD in Kigali, Rwanda. Its four primary services are Custom Tailoring & Suits; Clothing Alterations & Repairs; Garment Care & Cleaning; Mobile Tailoring, Styling & Event Assistance.

### Enquiries, quotations and acceptance

A website enquiry, chosen design or acknowledgement is not a confirmed order. Review the quotation, design, fabric, measurements, price and relevant conditions. Customer acceptance, required payment, availability/sourcing checks and official confirmation are separate steps; production also has a separate official start notice.

### Payments and release

Domestic custom garment orders require a 70% advance before production and the remaining 30% before release or delivery. For custom tailoring, the balance is due when tailoring is complete and before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment is required before garment release. Standalone alterations, cleaning, mobile assistance and VIP requests use the payment arrangement stated in the accepted quotation; do not assume the suit schedule applies to every service.

International custom orders require feasibility confirmation, quotation acceptance and 100% of the agreed quotation before production. Shipping and other applicable charges must be clearly quoted. No fixed international shipping cost or delivery time is promised without verified arrangements.

A payment screenshot is not proof that funds have been received. Production or service commencement requires verified payment and all necessary order requirements, followed by the applicable official confirmation and production-start notice. Use verified payment instructions from Mr Sewing Fashion; do not share payment PINs or account credentials.

### Design, fabric and availability

You may ask us to assess fabric you supply. Suitability, quantity, condition, design and any additional materials are checked before a quotation and acceptance. A reference photograph does not promise exact replication, exact fabric or colour availability. Alternatives and quotation changes require your agreement. Customer-supplied fabric does not automatically carry a blanket liability exclusion or refund forfeiture.

### Measurements, fittings and changes

Provide accurate information and follow the agreed measurement guidance. Clarify incomplete information and arrange fittings where applicable. Customer-requested changes are assessed for feasibility, quotation and scheduling before agreement; no universal change penalty is published.

### Timing and priorities

Standard Custom Tailoring & Suits takes 1–3 weeks. Express takes 2–3 days, subject to feasibility and capacity confirmation. Measurements, fabric/material availability, fittings and operational requirements may affect completion. Your actual completion date is agreed before order acceptance; a requested deadline is not automatically accepted.

Standard Clothing Alterations & Repairs takes 12–15 working hours; Express takes 2–12 working hours, subject to inspection, feasibility and capacity. Working hours are not consecutive clock hours or calendar days. The actual completion date is confirmed before acceptance.

Standard Garment Care & Cleaning takes approximately 3 days. Express garment care takes 2–12 hours, subject to confirmation, garment assessment and available capacity. No stain-removal or fabric-outcome guarantee is given. The actual completion date is agreed before acceptance.

Express adds 35% of the eligible quoted base service. Necessary and agreed after-hours work from 17:00 to 22:00 Kigali time adds 25% of the same eligible base. When both apply, the additive surcharge is 60%, not compounded. Charges are shown separately in the quotation for your agreement. Work after 22:00 requires an individual quotation and payment arrangement; there is no universal overnight percentage. Ordinary-service percentages are not automatically added to an individually agreed VIP quotation.

Calculation examples for an eligible 100,000 RWF base: Express totals 135,000 RWF; after-hours totals 125,000 RWF; both total 160,000 RWF. These illustrate the calculation, not a universal service price. No after-hours charge applies automatically if after-hours work is not needed and agreed.

Standard 24-hour and Express 2-hour order-confirmation targets apply only after required steps are complete. These are separate from production completion.

### Communication and production

Customer Support operates Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 Kigali time excluding Rwandan public holidays, with a first-response target within 24 support working hours. Keep official contact details and relevant order information available. The team provides confirmed updates; interruptions are assessed for their effect on the agreed date before a delay is communicated.

### Delivery, collection and storage

Eligible Kigali alterations and garment-care orders have a 10,000 RWF total collection-and-return charge for the round trip. The same order combining alterations and cleaning is not charged twice. Customer drop-off, professional visits, included initial Kigali custom-suit delivery and international shipping are different arrangements. Location eligibility and any separate arrangement are confirmed in the quotation; no nationwide delivery price is implied.

The standard Kigali custom-suit package includes initial standard cleaning, protective packaging and initial Kigali delivery. Additional/outside-Kigali arrangements are agreed separately. Confirm address, time and payment before dispatch. Reschedule with at least one hour’s notice; later/failed delivery may involve justified approved costs where applicable. Collection verification, written third-party authority, receipt and notification apply. Free storage is seven calendar days from the ready notification; written approval is needed for an extension. No forfeiture, resale or unapproved daily penalty is imposed.

### Corrections and workmanship

Report fitting/workmanship concerns promptly, preferably via WhatsApp; documented guidance is within 72 hours after receipt/collection without limiting statutory rights. Mr Sewing assesses company-caused errors, corrects feasible errors without an additional tailoring charge and may provide a company-funded remake if proper correction is impossible. Customer-supplied measurement errors need feasibility assessment; a replacement may need a separate quote.

### Complaints and refund requests

Use Customer Support or the refund request form with order details, reason and relevant evidence. Human review and a decision are required; submission does not approve a refund. No automatic percentage deduction, deposit forfeiture, Express-fee retention, universal penalty or guaranteed processing deadline is imposed here. Cancellation and refund arrangements are assessed individually; request clarification before accepting your quotation.

### Discounts and inclusions

Qualifying suits may receive the approved loyalty, referral, bulk or group customer discount. The highest eligible customer discount applies; discounts do not stack on one suit. Referral commission is separate. See the benefits guidance and confirm applicable procedures; do not assume unrelated-service, gift, extra-cleaning or transport benefits.

### Privacy, rights and limitations

Personal information is used for the request and service arrangements as described in the Privacy Policy. Confirm suitability and limitations for the actual garment/service rather than assuming every repair or treatment is possible. Nothing here removes applicable statutory customer rights. VIP-specific arrangements require an individual quotation and agreement.

### Mobile visits and individual VIP assistance

Order Measurement Visit: 10,000 RWF for a Kigali measurement visit after you accept the garment quotation and pay the required 70% garment advance. This separate visit fee does not add a second 25,000 RWF consultation charge merely for measuring an already-confirmed order.

Consultation & Fitting: 25,000 RWF for customers without a confirmed garment order who request professional measurement, fitting, garment-selection or planning assistance. This is a separately purchased service. Location, scope and appointment require confirmation.

Independent Tailoring Assistance: 50,000 RWF for the agreed independent tailoring, styling or event-assistance scope, up to five people and three hours. Exceeding either limit requires VIP assessment and an individually revised quotation. Confirm location eligibility and any travel arrangements before agreement.

VIP assistance is individually quoted for individual, family, event or group needs across tailoring, alterations, garment care and mobile/styling assistance. The quotation considers group size, time, location, service complexity and operational requirements. Standard mobile assistance exceeding five people or three hours needs VIP assessment. Scope, feasibility, payment arrangements and service confirmation must be agreed. No universal VIP price, unlimited service, free benefit, membership payment or guaranteed response time is promised. Approved VIP Express and after-hours assistance is addressed within the agreed VIP quotation.

## Refund & Cancellation Policy

Route: /refund-policy/

Submit a request for human assessment. An enquiry or form acknowledgement is not an approved refund.

### How to request a review

Use the request form below or official WhatsApp/email. Provide the order or quotation reference, your contact details, the issue, relevant dates and the remedy requested. Describe any receipt, payment or garment evidence you can supply; the team will explain how to share it. Do not send card details, payment PINs or ID scans.

### Review and decision

Support reviews the request with the relevant team, seeks clarification if needed and communicates the decision through WhatsApp or email. You may ask for further assistance or clarification. First-response guidance is within 24 support working hours during Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 Kigali time excluding Rwandan public holidays; this is not a refund-payment deadline.

### Fitting and workmanship concerns

Report promptly, preferably through WhatsApp. The documented guidance is within 72 hours after receipt/collection, without limiting statutory rights. Mr Sewing corrects feasible company-caused fitting/workmanship errors without an additional tailoring charge and may remake at company expense if proper correction is impossible. Other remedies remain subject to applicable customer rights.

### Customer-provided measurements

Correction feasibility is assessed. Not every supplied-measurement error can be corrected; an appropriate replacement may require a separate quotation under the applicable approved assistance arrangements.

### Cancellation and changes

Tell us promptly if you wish to cancel or change an order, service or visit. Include whether a quotation has been accepted, payment has been made, materials have been committed or work has started. Changes require feasibility, quotation and scheduling agreement before the team proceeds.

The team assesses your request and supporting information and communicates its decision. Submitting a request does not itself approve a refund or fix a deduction or payment date. These procedures do not remove applicable customer rights.

## Privacy Policy

Route: /privacy-policy/

Learn how Mr Sewing Fashion uses information provided through this website and how to contact us about your privacy.

### Who operates the website

Mr Sewing Fashion is the public brand of NINKONIYUMUTWARE NEXUS LTD, Kigali, Rwanda. Contact the business through the official email, phone or WhatsApp listed on the Contact page for privacy questions or requests.

### Information you provide

Quotation, support and refund forms collect the name, phone and optional email needed to respond, relevant location, selected service/preferences and your message. Design, measurement, address, order-reference and payment-related evidence may be discussed with the team as relevant. Do not enter payment PINs, full card details or identity scans in these forms.

### Forms, hosting and messaging

The website uses GitHub Pages for public-page deployment and Cloudflare Pages for text-enquiry validation and staging. Text enquiries are processed through Web3Forms, either directly or after validation. A successful provider response does not prove mailbox receipt. Hosting and network services process requests needed to operate the site. Choosing a WhatsApp, email, social or external link uses the relevant provider; its processing is separate from this website.

### Reference files and measurements

Website file uploads are disabled in the public forms. No reference files are attached to text enquiries. Customers may arrange reference or measurement sharing with the team through official communication channels.

The public forms do not use private website request or file storage in this release. A submission acknowledgement does not confirm a privately stored website record. Contact the business about the retention and deletion arrangements applicable to information shared through its providers and communication channels.

### Selections, cookies and analytics

The website keeps service/design/fabric choices in per-tab browser session storage. Quotation forms also keep a temporary per-tab draft of contact and request fields so navigation or editing need not lose your work. The code checks for a draft older than 30 minutes when reopening the form and clears it after an accepted submission; this is not a server or email-retention period. Browser storage can be unavailable, and a saved draft is not a submitted request.

Existing cart code can save product selections, not payment credentials, in browser local storage. Current enquiry-only Shop products do not activate a purchasing cart. No new analytics, advertising tracker or cookie-consent system is introduced by these changes. Legacy pages may load Font Awesome from cdnjs.cloudflare.com. Actual deployed cookies and external-provider practices require separate verification.

### Purposes and sharing

Information is used to assess requests, prepare quotations, communicate with you, arrange services, review complaints and provide requested follow-up. Hosting, form-submission, email and messaging providers process information needed for their part of these communications. A website enquiry is not permission to publish your photograph or testimonial.

### Privacy questions and requests

Contact Mr Sewing Fashion through the official contact details for questions about access, correction, deletion or other applicable privacy rights. Explain the request and relevant enquiry reference without sending passwords, payment PINs or unnecessary identity documents.

Data retention, provider processing and any international-transfer arrangements depend on the systems actually used and applicable requirements. This policy does not promise an unverified retention period, security certification or automatic deletion across email and messaging providers.

## Quotations, Orders & Service Guidance

Route: /customer-information/

Understand the steps between an enquiry, an agreed quotation and an officially confirmed service.

### Your request is the beginning

Choose the relevant service, describe your garment or assistance needs, and request a quotation. Sending a request or choosing a design does not confirm production, payment or availability.

### From enquiry to production

The sequence is: customer enquiry; quotation; customer acceptance; required payment; availability and final sourcing checks; official order confirmation; a separate official production-start notice; production and fitting; final balance; collection or delivery.

Standard order-confirmation target: 24 hours after the required steps are complete. Express order-confirmation target: 2 hours after the required steps are complete. These are confirmation targets, not garment-completion promises.

### Custom-suit payment stages

Domestic custom garment orders require a 70% advance before production and the remaining 30% before release or delivery. For custom tailoring, the balance is due when tailoring is complete and before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment is required before garment release. Standalone alterations, cleaning, mobile assistance and VIP requests use the payment arrangement stated in the accepted quotation; do not assume the suit schedule applies to every service.

International custom orders require feasibility confirmation, quotation acceptance and 100% of the agreed quotation before production. Shipping and other applicable charges must be clearly quoted. No fixed international shipping cost or delivery time is promised without verified arrangements.

A payment screenshot is not proof that funds have been received. Production or service commencement requires verified payment and all necessary order requirements, followed by the applicable official confirmation and production-start notice. Use verified payment instructions from Mr Sewing Fashion; do not share payment PINs or account credentials.

### Standard and Express Priority

Express adds 35% of the eligible quoted base service. Necessary and agreed after-hours work from 17:00 to 22:00 Kigali time adds 25% of the same eligible base. When both apply, the additive surcharge is 60%, not compounded. Charges are shown separately in the quotation for your agreement. Work after 22:00 requires an individual quotation and payment arrangement; there is no universal overnight percentage. Ordinary-service percentages are not automatically added to an individually agreed VIP quotation.

Calculation examples for an eligible 100,000 RWF base: Express totals 135,000 RWF; after-hours totals 125,000 RWF; both total 160,000 RWF. These illustrate the calculation, not a universal service price. No after-hours charge applies automatically if after-hours work is not needed and agreed.

### Hours and overnight requests

Normal operating hours are 09:00–17:00 Kigali time. Requests for work after 22:00 are individually reviewed and quoted; there is no universal overnight surcharge. Confirm visit and work availability before relying on arrangements.

### Your communications and updates

Customer Support operates Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Kigali time, excluding Rwandan public holidays. The first-response target is within 24 support working hours, not 24 consecutive clock hours and not a refund-payment deadline.

The team communicates about quotations, payment confirmation, fabric availability, official production start, important changes, fittings, garment readiness, final payment and delivery or collection. If an interruption arises, its effect on the agreed completion date is assessed before a delay is announced. Confirmed issues and realistic revised arrangements are then discussed. This website does not provide live order tracking.

### Service completion estimates

Standard Custom Tailoring & Suits takes 1–3 weeks. Express takes 2–3 days, subject to feasibility and capacity confirmation. Measurements, fabric/material availability, fittings and operational requirements may affect completion. Your actual completion date is agreed before order acceptance; a requested deadline is not automatically accepted.

Standard Clothing Alterations & Repairs takes 12–15 working hours; Express takes 2–12 working hours, subject to inspection, feasibility and capacity. Working hours are not consecutive clock hours or calendar days. The actual completion date is confirmed before acceptance.

## Delivery, Collection & Storage

Route: /delivery-and-collection/

Agree the practical handover arrangements and check your ready notification.

### Included and separately agreed arrangements

The documented standard Kigali custom-suit package includes initial standard cleaning, protective packaging and initial Kigali delivery. Included services are not charged again. Additional delivery and outside-Kigali arrangements require an agreed quotation where applicable; no shipping cost or delivered-by deadline is assumed.

Eligible Kigali alterations and garment-care orders have a 10,000 RWF total collection-and-return charge for the round trip. The same order combining alterations and cleaning is not charged twice. Customer drop-off, professional visits, included initial Kigali custom-suit delivery and international shipping are different arrangements. Location eligibility and any separate arrangement are confirmed in the quotation; no nationwide delivery price is implied.

### Before dispatch

The team confirms the delivery address and time, verifies required payment and records delivery completion. Customers should provide accurate contact and address details and be available for the agreed arrangements.

### Changes and unsuccessful delivery

The documented rescheduling policy allows at least one hour’s notice. Later changes or failed delivery may involve justified approved additional costs, agreed as applicable; no automatic flat fee is published. If the company causes a missed delivery, contact Support for the applicable business-responsibility arrangements. The exact reimbursement/remedy rule still requires source reconciliation; do not assume a customer-caused fee applies.

### Collection and authorised collectors

Collection requires full payment where applicable and appropriate identity or collection verification. Another collector needs written authorisation. A collection receipt and notification to the original customer are used where applicable. Do not send ID scans through this website form.

### Storage after readiness

Seven calendar days of free storage run from the ready notification. Any extension needs individual approval and written confirmation. No daily storage penalty, garment forfeiture, abandonment or resale condition is published.

Men’s ordinary suits: Tier 1 — two-piece 600,000 RWF, three-piece 650,000 RWF; Tier 2 — two-piece 400,000 RWF, three-piece 450,000 RWF; Tier 3 — two-piece 270,000 RWF, three-piece 320,000 RWF; Tier 4 — two-piece 200,000 RWF, three-piece 250,000 RWF. Women’s ordinary suits: Tier 1 — two-piece 500,000 RWF, three-piece 550,000 RWF; Tier 2 — two-piece 350,000 RWF, three-piece 400,000 RWF; Tier 3 — two-piece 220,000 RWF, three-piece 270,000 RWF; Tier 4 — two-piece 150,000 RWF, three-piece 200,000 RWF. Men’s tuxedos, separate schedule: Tier 1 — two-piece 800,000 RWF, three-piece 1,000,000 RWF; Tier 2 — two-piece 600,000 RWF, three-piece 800,000 RWF. These are complete garment starting prices, not fabric-only prices. Your selected fabric, design, inclusions and service requirements are reviewed before the final quotation is confirmed. See the Fabric Guide for the approved fabric tiers and photographs.

### How should I arrange and verify payment?

Mobile Money, Bank Transfer and Cryptocurrency are manually arranged payment options in the Shop. Wait for verified instructions from Mr Sewing Fashion; no automatic gateway or payment confirmation is provided. A screenshot is not proof of received funds. Never share payment PINs, passwords or private keys. For service enquiries, follow the payment method and requirements in your agreed quotation.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#3

### Where is Mr Sewing based?

The main workshop is in Karama, Norvège, KN 441 St, Nyarugenge, Kigali. The Downtown consultation location is in MIC Building, Downtown Kigali, by appointment. See the Contact page for the workshop map and the appropriate visit arrangements.

Source link: /contact/#locations-heading

### Do I need an appointment?

Normal workshop hours are Monday–Saturday, 09:00–17:00 Kigali time. Ordinary Saturday workshop visits do not require an appointment. On the last Saturday of the month (Umuganda), hours are 12:00–17:00 by advance appointment; Sunday is by appointment only. The MIC Building consultation location is appointment-only. Mobile appointments and after-hours work require confirmation. Customer Support separately operates Monday–Friday, excluding Rwandan public holidays.

Source link: /contact/#hours-heading

### How long does a custom suit take?

Standard Custom Tailoring & Suits takes 1–3 weeks. Express takes 2–3 days, subject to feasibility and capacity confirmation. Measurements, fabric/material availability, fittings and operational requirements may affect completion. Your actual completion date is agreed before order acceptance; a requested deadline is not automatically accepted.

Source link: /services/custom-tailoring/#service-info-timing

### How do I ask for a refund review?

Use the refund request form with your order or quotation reference, contact details, reason, relevant dates, evidence and the remedy you request. The team reviews the circumstances, may ask for clarification and communicates the decision through WhatsApp or email. You may ask for further assistance. Submitting the form does not approve a refund or determine its amount or payment date.

Source link: /refund-policy/#1

### Can I change my design after payment?

Contact the team before requesting a change to design, fabric, colour or measurements. Ask whether the change is feasible and how it would affect the quotation, work and schedule before deciding how to proceed.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#5

### How are website form details processed?

Text enquiries use Web3Forms, directly or through the website’s Cloudflare validation endpoint. Website file uploads are not required. Selected website designs are shared as photograph URLs, not attached files. The quotation form also saves a temporary per-tab draft of contact and request fields to preserve your progress; this is not an accepted request or a private order record. See the Privacy Policy for browser-storage information.

Source link: /privacy-policy/#5

### Can I have my suit altered within four days?

Four days is normally longer than the published Standard alterations estimate of 12–15 working hours. Inspection, operating hours, fittings and confirmed capacity still determine the agreed completion date. Mentioning a four-day deadline does not automatically require Express service or an Express fee.

Source link: /services/alterations/#service-info-timing

### What is the after-hours fee?

Express adds 35% of the eligible quoted base service. Necessary and agreed after-hours work from 17:00 to 22:00 Kigali time adds 25% of the same eligible base. When both apply, the additive surcharge is 60%, not compounded. Charges are shown separately in the quotation for your agreement. Work after 22:00 requires an individual quotation and payment arrangement; there is no universal overnight percentage. Ordinary-service percentages are not automatically added to an individually agreed VIP quotation.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#6

### What happens after 22:00?

Work after 22:00 needs an individual quotation and payment arrangement. There is no universal overnight percentage, and availability must be confirmed.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#6

### What deposit must I pay and when is the balance due?

Domestic custom garment orders require a 70% advance before production and the remaining 30% before release or delivery. For custom tailoring, the balance is due when tailoring is complete and before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment is required before garment release. Standalone alterations, cleaning, mobile assistance and VIP requests use the payment arrangement stated in the accepted quotation; do not assume the suit schedule applies to every service. A payment screenshot is not proof that funds have been received. Production or service commencement requires verified payment and all necessary order requirements, followed by the applicable official confirmation and production-start notice. Use verified payment instructions from Mr Sewing Fashion; do not share payment PINs or account credentials.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#3

### Do international customers pay in full?

International custom orders require feasibility confirmation, quotation acceptance and 100% of the agreed quotation before production. Shipping and other applicable charges must be clearly quoted. No fixed international shipping cost or delivery time is promised without verified arrangements.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#3

### Is international shipping included?

International shipping and other applicable charges are clearly quoted before agreement. Do not assume that initial Kigali delivery in an eligible suit package includes international shipping. No fixed international shipping price or deadline is promised without verified arrangements.

Source link: /terms-and-conditions/#3

### How much is Kigali collection and return?

Eligible Kigali alterations and garment-care orders have a 10,000 RWF total collection-and-return charge for the round trip. The same order combining alterations and cleaning is not charged twice. Customer drop-off, professional visits, included initial Kigali custom-suit delivery and international shipping are different arrangements. Location eligibility and any separate arrangement are confirmed in the quotation; no nationwide delivery price is implied.

Source link: /delivery-and-collection/#1

### Can someone visit my workplace for measurements?

Order Measurement Visit: 10,000 RWF for a Kigali measurement visit after you accept the garment quotation and pay the required 70% garment advance. This separate visit fee does not add a second 25,000 RWF consultation charge merely for measuring an already-confirmed order. If you have not confirmed a garment order, the separately purchased 25,000 RWF Consultation & Fitting service may suit your needs. Share your Kigali location; timing, scope, feasibility and any travel arrangements require confirmation.

Source link: /services/mobile-fitting/#service-info-mobile

### How are VIP services priced?

VIP assistance is individually quoted for individual, family, event or group needs across tailoring, alterations, garment care and mobile/styling assistance. The quotation considers group size, time, location, service complexity and operational requirements. Standard mobile assistance exceeding five people or three hours needs VIP assessment. Scope, feasibility, payment arrangements and service confirmation must be agreed. No universal VIP price, unlimited service, free benefit, membership payment or guaranteed response time is promised. Approved VIP Express and after-hours assistance is addressed within the agreed VIP quotation.

Source link: /services/vip/#service-info-vip

### What happens if my requested deadline cannot be accepted?

A requested date is not automatically confirmed. The team assesses the garment, materials, measurements, fittings and capacity before acceptance. Agree a feasible completion date and quotation before proceeding; do not assume that selecting Express guarantees the deadline.

Source link: /customer-information/#service-estimates
